chapterArc: Beliefs: why each profession feels protected

continuity.cast: Guide identity and each profession variant remain stable.

semanticAnalysis.action: guide reveals one quarter of the company
semanticAnalysis.negation: Preserve any quoted denial or not-alone relationship exactly.
semanticAnalysis.notes: Read with neighboring cues; do not turn belief into verified fact.

Abstract evidence diagram for 60 thousand is about one quarter.
designDecision.composition: guide stands beside a hundred-person card
designDecision.actionPeak: guide points at the highlighted quarter
designDecision.why: Literal geometry protects the numerical relationship.

referenceUse: Borrow staging, silhouette density, material and motion mechanism from ref_003_office_headcount_card.jpg.

copyLedger.explanation: Wording either quotes the cue or condenses its stated meaning without adding a claim.

factBasis.explanation: Value is supplied by the cue, derived from its stated relationship, or used as documented editorial identity.

animationPlan.primaryAction: guide reveals one quarter of the company
animationPlan.motivation: Literal geometry protects the numerical relationship.
animationPlan.anticipation: guide and workforce orient head and weight toward the acting object before contact.
animationPlan.contact: guide points at the highlighted quarter; hands and any held prop share the same rig socket.
animationPlan.weightShift: Standing actors shift over the supporting foot; seated actors remain anchored through hips and chair.
animationPlan.actionPeak: guide points at the highlighted quarter
animationPlan.followThrough: The action settles with a readable hold before expand outward to multiple companies.
animationPlan.secondaryMotion: headcount diagram uses offset breathing, tool response or environmental motion without synchronized looping.
animationPlan.gaze: Head direction leads toward the active hand, evidence or conversation partner.
animationPlan.cameraMotivation: balanced guide and data framing supports the narrated relationship rather than decorative drift.

review.start: Opening state establishes headcount diagram with readable subject hierarchy.
review.middle: Action peak checked: guide points at the highlighted quarter.
review.end: Final hold leaves the narrated relationship legible before expand outward to multiple companies.
issues: Checked hand contact, text collisions, floor contact and unsupported factual additions.
fixes: Aligned held props to wrists, corrected baselines and separated text bands where required.
